title: 第11章 炼化蛟龙血突破灵纹四重第12章 剑斩血傀夺太苍令牌
content_zh:
第11章炼化蛟龙血，突破灵纹四重！
大长老脸色阴沉，犹豫了片刻。
柳嫣然不仅是武极宗圣女，还有深厚背景。
大长老动谁都不敢动她！
大长老没想到，柳嫣然会不顾自身性命危险，前来相救林尘！
只是一瞬间的耽搁，宗主已经追了上来，拦住大长老。
“武极宗会武，弟子争斗有伤亡在所难免，大长老，你想直接处决林尘，未免也太急了！”
“就算林尘有罪，也应该由长老会商议，最后由本宗主来决断！”
宗主冷哼一声，感觉很没面子，大长老的行为，明显越界了。
这些年，大长老在武极宗拉拢了不少党羽，行事越发肆无忌惮。
“宗主，此子残害同门，难道不该杀？”
大长老怒斥。
“你眼睛瞎了？看不到是皇甫逸先动了杀心！
他想杀林公子，难道还不准林公子反抗？”
柳嫣然硬刚大长老，众目睽睽之下，一点面子不给。
大长老脸色越发阴沉，却也无可奈何。
事已至此，大长老现在不可能镇杀林尘，只能以后再找林尘清算。
“林尘，武极宗会武，你夺得第一，按照规定，可以获得奖励。”
宗主冷冷盯着大长老，让他去取会武奖励。
大长老气得当场拂袖离去，由其他长老前来发放奖励。

一滴蛟龙血，盛放在玉瓶之中，散发出强大的气息。
蛟龙血极为珍贵，对拥有龙类武魂的林尘而言帮助极大。
此外，还有极品聚灵丹一百颗，以及地阶极品灵器，凌风剑！
剑长三尺，通体寒光闪闪，林尘握住剑柄，挥剑，发出一道剑鸣声，仿若龙吟。
剑鸣清脆，确实是一把好剑。
地阶极品灵器，在青州城境内，属于珍宝。
武极宗会武拿出的奖励，确实丰厚。
“林尘，你先回去，皇甫逸之事，我自会秉公处理。”
宗主拍了拍林尘肩膀，脸上带着一抹笑意。
林尘的天赋，他很是欣赏，而且此子行事果断，不拖泥带水，心性极佳。
若是林尘武魂还在，宗主都想收他为亲传弟子，好好栽培了。
“谢过宗主。”
“嫣然，多谢了。”
林尘向宗主和柳嫣然抱了抱拳。
content_en:
Chapter 11: Refining dragon blood and breaking through the fourth level of spiritual patterns!
The great elder looked gloomy and hesitated for a moment.
Liu Yanran is not only a saint of Wuji Sect, but also has a profound background.
No one dares to touch her if the Great Elder touches her!
The Great Elder did not expect that Liu Yanran would come to save Lin Chen regardless of the danger to his own life!
After just a moment's delay, the sect leader had already caught up and stopped the great elder.
"In the Wuji Sect's martial arts competition, casualties among disciples are inevitable. Great Elder, if you want to execute Lin Chen directly, it is too hasty!"
"Even if Lin Chen is guilty, it should be discussed by the Council of Elders, and the final decision should be made by this sect leader!"
The sect leader snorted coldly, feeling very humiliated. The behavior of the great elder clearly crossed the line.
Over the years, the Great Elder has attracted many members of the Wuji Sect, and his actions have become more and more unscrupulous.
"Sect Master, this son harmed his fellow sect members, shouldn't he be killed?"
The great elder scolded angrily.
"Are you blind? You can't see that it was Huangfu Yi who had murderous intentions first!
He wants to kill Young Master Lin, so why shouldn't Young Master Lin be allowed to resist? "
Liu Yanran stood up to the elder and refused to give him any face in front of everyone.
The great elder's face became more and more gloomy, but there was nothing he could do.
The matter has come to this. It is impossible for the Great Elder to kill Lin Chen now, and he can only find Lin Chen to deal with him later.
"Lin Chen, if you win the first place in Wuji Zong's martial arts competition, you can get a reward according to the regulations."
The sect leader stared at the great elder coldly and asked him to get the martial arts reward.
The great elder was so angry that he walked away on the spot, and other elders came to distribute the rewards.
A drop of dragon's blood was placed in a jade bottle, exuding a powerful aura.
Dragon blood is extremely precious and is of great help to Lin Chen, who possesses a dragon-like martial spirit.
In addition, there are a hundred top-grade spirit-gathering pills, as well as the top-grade spiritual weapon of the earth level, Ling Feng Sword!
The sword was three feet long and gleamed with cold light. Lin Chen held the hilt of the sword and swung the sword, making a sword sound, like a dragon's roar.
The sound of the sword is clear and crisp, and it is indeed a good sword.
The top-grade spiritual weapon of the earth level is a treasure within the territory of Qingzhou City.
The rewards offered by Wu Jizong Huiwu are indeed generous.
"Lin Chen, you go back first. I will handle Huangfu Yi's matter impartially."
The sect leader patted Lin Chen on the shoulder with a smile on his face.
He admired Lin Chen's talent very much, and he was decisive, not sloppy, and had a very good character.
If Lin Chen's martial spirit was still there, the sect master would want to accept him as his direct disciple and train him well.
"Thank you, Sect Master."
"Yanran, thank you very much."
Lin Chen hugged his fists to the sect leader and Liu Yanran.
